User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account in the SplitWisePro application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for authentication and login.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture, typically obtained from an OAuth provider.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a collection of users who share expenses together.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Group entity.

name.description: The name of the group (e.g., 'Vacation Crew', 'Housemates').

description.description: An optional description of the group's purpose or context.

creatorId.description: Reference to the User who created this group. (Relationship: User 1:N Group)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the group was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the group was last updated.

GroupMember.title: GroupMember
GroupMember.description: Represents a user's membership within a specific group, linking users to groups.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GroupMember entity.

groupId.description: Reference to the Group this membership belongs to. (Relationship: Group 1:N GroupMember)

userId.description: Reference to the User who is a member of this group. (Relationship: User 1:N GroupMember)

joinedAt.description: Timestamp when the user joined the group.

nickname.description: An optional nickname for the user specific to this group, if they prefer to be called something else within this context.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a single shared expense recorded within a group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

groupId.description: Reference to the Group to which this expense belongs. (Relationship: Group 1:N Expense)

description.description: A brief description of what the expense was for (e.g., 'Groceries', 'Internet Bill').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the expense.

paidById.description: Reference to the User who initially paid the full amount of this expense. (Relationship: User 1:N Expense)

expenseDate.description: The date and time when the expense occurred.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was last updated.

ExpenseShare.title: ExpenseShare
ExpenseShare.description: Represents a specific user's share or responsibility for a portion of an expense.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExpenseShare entity.

expenseId.description: Reference to the Expense this share is part of. (Relationship: Expense 1:N ExpenseShare)

userId.description: Reference to the User who is responsible for this share of the expense. (Relationship: User 1:N ExpenseShare)

shareAmount.description: The exact monetary amount this user is responsible for in this expense. The sum of all ExpenseShare amounts for an expense should equal the Expense's totalAmount.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the expense share record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the expense share record was last updated.

Settlement.title: Settlement
Settlement.description: Records a payment made between two members within a group to settle outstanding debts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Settlement entity.

groupId.description: Reference to the Group where this settlement occurred. (Relationship: Group 1:N Settlement)

payerId.description: Reference to the User who made the payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Settlement - Payer)

receiverId.description: Reference to the User who received the payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Settlement - Receiver)

amount.description: The monetary amount of the settlement payment.

settlementDate.description: The date and time when the settlement payment was made.

description.description: An optional description or note about the settlement.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the settlement record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the settlement record was last updated.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique ID of the group.
